purpose: Illustrative interpretations, not source Bible content
shared_brief: Detailed painterly realism; historically plausible biblical surroundings; blue and warm gold natural light; readable on a phone. No text, numbers, watermark, modern objects, graphic violence or anthropomorphic depiction of God.

images.brief: Symbolic desolate ancient Judean terraces, olive tree, clouds and sunrise, evoking the troubled land described by Ezekiel; no people.
Gideon standing among ancient hills in linen clothing; gentle light suggests reassurance and courage, without combat or a personified divine figure.
